meta.note: New experiments E-*. Existing experiments OUT-X1..X14 (outline v1) and GM experiments 1-3 are referenced, not duplicated. cost: low (<1 GPU-day or public data only) | medium | high.

experiments.title: Latent vs surface diversity across model ensembles
experiments.design: Sample N frontier/open models on Infinity-Chat-style open prompts; compute delta_surface (style embeddings) and delta_latent (content embeddings with style regressed out); estimate effective N_e of the model ecosystem.
experiments.prediction: delta_surface >> delta_latent; effective N_e << number of models.

experiments.title: Reasoning gap vs grounded gain
experiments.design: For a task family with a verifier and one without, measure pass@k curves for base, sharpened (self-SFT), RLVR, and distilled models; score on held-out world-grounded probes.
experiments.prediction: Sharpening/RLVR raise pass@1 and lower large-k coverage; only distillation/verifier channels raise grounded probes.

experiments.title: Literariness as epoch tolerance and aesthetic distance
experiments.design: Matched canonical vs genre corpora (Project Gutenberg / HathiTrust with prestige labels per Underwood). (a) Repeat each document k epochs in continued pretraining and measure held-out gain decay; (b) KL to genre-conditioned LM of the text's period; (c) long-range MI tails.
experiments.prediction: Canonical texts: slower epoch-gain decay, higher period-KL, heavier MI tails, controlling length and survival.

experiments.title: Migration-drift balance in synthetic training ecosystems
experiments.design: M small LMs trained iteratively on a pooled corpus with controllable source divergence delta, attention weights w (setting N_e), fresh-data rate mu, and verifier fraction v; track latent diversity and grounded probe accuracy.
experiments.prediction: Stationary diversity fits 4 N_e m/(1+4 N_e m) with m increasing in delta; collapse at low N_e*delta unless v>v*.

experiments.title: Rogers chain with stateful world
experiments.design: As E-04 but Omega drifts (e.g., rotating seasonal phase); vary v; include a reflexive term where agents' outputs shift Omega.
experiments.prediction: Threshold v* rising with drift rate; reflexive term inflates apparent fit (Delta F_perform) while grounded fit falls.

experiments.title: Era-sliced snapshots
experiments.design: Train/finetune models on decade-sliced corpora (e.g., 1850s, 1900s, 1950s); compare geometry of shared families and alignment across eras; probe implicit dates in a pooled model.
data: HathiTrust / Google Books ngrams / Chronicling America
experiments.prediction: Pooled model's implied world is a temporal composite; alignment between eras below within-era ceiling, with breaks at known shocks.

experiments.title: Interpretive diversity of human vs model readings
experiments.design: Collect human and model interpretations of canonical and pulp passages; measure latent diversity of interpretations; repeat across model generations.
experiments.prediction: Model interpretations less diverse, converging on modal readings; canonical texts sustain more human interpretive diversity.

experiments.title: Resonance of model deviations
experiments.design: Apply Barron et al. novelty/transience to (a) historical corpora with known later-ratified ideas, (b) model outputs at varied temperature with/without tools; check later grounding of high-novelty items.
experiments.prediction: Resonance predicts later ratification; tool access raises the share of resonant high-novelty model outputs.

experiments.title: Sleeping beauties in literature and science
experiments.design: Compute beauty coefficients (Ke 2015) on citation/mention time series for literary authors (e.g., Hopkins, Donne, Beowulf in criticism) and for distributional semantics (Firth/Harris citations); identify awakening hubs.
experiments.prediction: Awakenings coincide with identifiable hub attachments and frame shifts; rediscovery probability declines with field volume.

experiments.title: Performative fit decomposition
experiments.design: Estimate Delta F_perform as change in model-human agreement attributable to human text moving toward model text (excess-vocabulary methods), vs Delta F_learn from model updates on frozen human text.

experiments.title: Gaslighting/sycophancy precision curve
experiments.design: Vary user pushback strength and model's own-evidence strength; fit precision-weighted update; measure I(truth; final answer).
experiments.prediction: Information about truth falls as effective self-precision ratio falls; sycophancy-trained models sit closer to the gaslit regime.

experiments.title: Archival tail loss vs model tail loss
experiments.design: Apply Chao1/unseen-species estimators to model output distributions over generations, paralleling Kestemont's survival estimates.
experiments.prediction: Same estimator reveals tail loss in both; low-evenness categories lost first.
